members.name: vwap_slope_momentum_v1
members.thesis: VWAP slope (rate of change of VWAP) reflects the average price trajectory weighted by volume — it's a volume-weighted trend indicator. When VWAP slope is steep and price stays above VWAP, institutional accumulation is likely in progress. The inefficiency exists because most traders look at VWAP leve
members.exit_stop: vwap level at time of entry
filters: no entry first 30 min (VWAP unstable) or last 30 min
prefer trades in direction of nifty VWAP slope
weaknesses: VWAP slope is noisy early in the session when cumulative volume is low. The 30-min no-trade filter helps but doesn't eliminate early noise.
Late-entry problem: by the time VWAP slope z-score sustains at 1.5+ for 5 bars, a significant portion of the move is done.
VWAP slope naturally flattens as the day progresses (cumulative average effect). The signal becomes weaker in the afternoon by construction.
members.prior_art: VWAP slope analysis is less common in literature. Closest: institutional VWAP execution literature and TWAP benchmarking.

members.name: vwap_slope_trend_v1
members.thesis: The slope of VWAP over a rolling 20-bar window reveals the direction of institutional net order flow. A rising VWAP slope means institutions are net buying at progressively higher prices; a falling slope means net selling. Trading in the direction of the VWAP slope captures the institutional order f
members.exit_target: 0.5% from entry OR vwap_slope reverses sign
filters: no specific filter — trend strategies work across VIX regimes
no entries before 09:45 (slope needs data) or after 15:00
NIFTY 50 slope should align (both positive or both negative for added confidence)
weaknesses: VWAP slope is a lagging indicator — by the time slope confirms a trend, much of the move may be done
In choppy markets with ADX < 20, slope oscillates around zero giving false signals; ADX filter helps but reduces opportunity set
Slope calculation via linear regression is sensitive to outlier bars — a single large bar can distort slope reading
